scene: Two community-theater organizers adapt a performance after learning that an accessibility accommodation conflicts with part of the current staging. The change is feasible but requires rehearsal, and assumptions were made without consulting the affected audience.

role_a.name: Avery
role_a.profile: Explain difficult points in plain language and check whether the explanation landed. Adapt to questions instead of repeating the same wording.

role_b.name: Casey
role_b.profile: Test claims for missing assumptions and inconvenient counterexamples. Challenge ideas without dismissing the person, and acknowledge when a concern has been answered.

route_note: Two role-conditioned streams generate content and timing through shared acoustic feedback.
